texts.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
我们小心翼翼地将[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]推向了更民主的思想，而在我们到达之前，他们的世界还是原始的精英独裁型统治盛行。他们渐渐意识到了个人价值的重要性。
texts.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
We have carefully nudged the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] towards more democratic ideals, in place of the primitive despotism that was prevalent on their world before we arrived. They are beginning to appreciate the value of the individual.

label.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
label.en: They will thank us one day.
